title: Publisher discovery
description: One RTMP port for many publishers. Each one that arrives is reported as a candidate ready for source.add.

rtmp_port.title: RTMP port
rtmp_port.description: The port every publisher uses. Only one process can hold it, so run either this device or an ingest/rtmp source on it, not both.

app.title: Application name
app.description: Accept publishers on this application name only. Empty accepts any, which is what makes a publisher appear with nothing configured at either end.
